column1: # Russian glosses for the words that actually appear in generated drills.
# Written for this project, from knowledge of Estonian -- NOT scraped. Sõnaveeb
# asks not to be batched, and `sonapi` is deliberately single-lookup only, so
# there is no licence-clean way to fetch 300 words and no intention of finding
# one. This file is the alternative: it ships with the app, needs no network,
# Why it exists: measured across every generator, 0 % of drill lemmas had a
# stored translation on a fresh deployment. The gloss store fills on demand,
# one word at a time, so `etendus` stays untranslated until somebody looks it
# up -- and a B1 object-case drill on a word the learner cannot translate
# teaches morphology on a token. CLAUDE.md names that failure; this closes it
# for the words it actually happens on.
# A Sõnaveeb answer is richer (senses, rection, muuttüüp) and still wins: this
# only fills `russian`, and the word card fetches the rest on demand.
